name: proprietor
concept: The Gilman House hotel clerk: a sallow, heavy man of fifty with the first signs of the Innsmouth look, flat wide mouth, thinning slicked hair, a stained white shirt with sleeve garters, a dark waistcoat, dark trousers, a watch chain.
